patterns.name: Routines vs. listeners
patterns.what: A routine wakes a bot on a clock ("every weekday at 8"). A listener wakes it when something happens, like a new email, a Slack mention or a webhook. Clocks suit digests. Listeners suit "tell me when X arrives" jobs, where polling burns tokens on empty runs.

patterns.name: Arena & parallel candidates
patterns.what: For work that matters, run several agents (or models) on the same task in parallel, then keep the best or merge them. You trade some compute for a much better result, and a second opinion catches the confident mistakes a single agent makes.
